transport: OpenSSH argv-only client, quoted fixed Python worker, JSON stdin
requires: shared work directory visible to batch nodes
unsupported: job daemonization or hostile research executable
state_policy: queue/accounting identity mismatch, empty/duplicate rows, unsupported/contradictory states -> sticky unknown, hard stop, never resubmit; scancel acceptance is only cancel_requested
deadline_policy: Persist absolute deadline, refuse expired queued work, supervisor walltime bound, sbatch no-requeue and time limit; caller timeout requests cancellation but never claims completion
acceptance: Local trusted fake sbatch/squeue/sacct/scancel tests only. No configured real cluster lifecycle run; no real SLURM support acceptance claimed.
